title: GAVEL: TOWARDS RULE-BASED SAFETY THROUGH ACTIVATION MONITORING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the activation-based detection of racist content generation by defining logical rules over internal model states (Cognitive Elements such as 'Ethnoracial Identity' combined with 'Hate Speech' or 'Threaten'). The methodology uses custom multi-turn conversational datasets and the external ToxiGen benchmark for ethnoracism to measure True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR).

Measuring the framework's ability to detect anti-LGBTQ content by monitoring intermediate model activations for specific Cognitive Elements (e.g., 'LGBTQ+' combined with 'Hate Speech'). Performance is evaluated on generated misuse conversations and the ToxiGen benchmark for homophobia.

Assessing the model's detection of election-related propaganda and political risk by tracking internal activations for Cognitive Elements like 'Electoral Politics' and 'Create Content', evaluated using custom dialogue datasets and the Reasoning Shield benchmark.
